messages:
Maya (PM): User feedback from support: when switching org->project scope the legend order stays "global-first" which confuses users who expect project tokens to be prioritized. Also CSV export loses the legend order. Screenshot: https://files.internal/redwood/legend-order-confuse.png

Ken (Designer): Thanks. I propose two changes: 1) make legend order context-aware (project scoped shows project tokens first), 2) persist that order in the export. I added an annotated mock in Figma with a subtle divider between project and global buckets.

Liu (Frontend): Implementation note: we'll need to thread scope into the legend component and into the export endpoint. For exports, suggest we include a new header row "legend_order: project-first" so consumers know ordering. Also dropdown for sorting: by spend / tokens / alphabetical.

Rohit (Data): Good call. Backend can return token buckets with a `context_priority` flag so FE doesn't reconstruct order. For CSV schema: include columns token_label, token_id, scope (org/project/global), cost_usd, tokens_count. I'll add this to the exporter PR.

Sam (Accessibility): A few a11y requests:
- Announce legend changes via an aria-live polite region so screen reader users know the order changed after scope toggle.
- Ensure exported CSV has human-readable headers and avoid abbreviations.
- Keyboard: add shortcut hint ("g then l" to focus legend) in the help menu, but only if it doesn't conflict. We should test that with NVDA/VoiceOver.

Ken (Designer): Also thinking about color mapping: some token labels are visually similar (two blues). Suggest using patterned chip borders for tokens that frequently get confused and add a hover tooltip showing exact spend + token id.

Liu (Frontend): Patterned borders + tooltips are doable but increases DOM nodes. We'll lazy-render patterns for >6 tokens. For the aria-live, I'll use a visually-hidden region with id="legend-announcer" and update text like "Legend reordered: showing project tokens first".

Maya (PM): Action items: @Ken update figma with divider + pattern notes, @Rohit add context_priority to exporter payload, @Liu wire legend order + aria-live + include header in CSV, @Sam test with assistive tech. Follow-up demo Wed 9:30am PT.

BillingBot: Export task #EXP-998 queued for acct-2345 (includes legend_order header).

Liu (Frontend): I'll open a draft PR and include a small sample CSV in the PR description for QA to validate order and headers.
